_notes: Null `cur` = key missing from the ar locale; all 636 are translated. Agency: imperative, concise, أنت singular (the operator). University: formal, analytical, singular address (جامعتك); documents.sharingRule/subtitle used plural معكم/جامعتكم and are aligned to the singular used everywhere else.

Numeric ranges: every range is rendered as «من X إلى Y» (agency:v29.plan.offer.range, university:metric.period). No en dash between numbers: with Western digits in RTL text a dash range can be read in either direction. Latin tokens (D-30 / D+30, D-2/D-4, SLA, SAML, OpenID Connect, Client secret, CHSI, KTX) kept intact.

Plural families: every family touched carries all six CLDR forms (_zero/_one/_two/_few/_many/_other) with {{count}} in each (the applier checks placeholders against the English, so number-word forms without {{count}} are not used). Pattern: one «1 مستند», two «2 مستندان», few «3 مستندات», many «11 مستندًا», other/zero «100 مستند». Count-bearing strings with no plural family were phrased count-neutrally (students.subCount, today.pipelineSub, v27.stage.stalled, v29.plan.usedSoFar, university:v25.chip.days).

Intake (입학 시기) was «موعد القبول» (= admission date), confusable with the adjacent Deadline column; now «فصل الالتحاق» everywhere (agency cols, work/filters allIntakes, university filters, v30.def.visaOutcome). Same change in the marketing/common patch.
Insights nav was «الإحصاءات» (statistics) in both consoles while university:v28.pipe.label already said «التحليلات»; unified on «التحليلات».
Not admitted = «غير مقبول», never «مرفوض» (rejected) in closed-count strings (agency:v22.work.closedHint, university:v22.closed/closedN).
Financial sponsor = «الممول» (agency:ws.sponsor), not «كفيل», which in the Gulf means the iqama/residency sponsor. Owner may confirm.

Verify/verified = «تحقق» family throughout (guides, documents); notarization = «التوثيق لدى كاتب العدل», legalization = «التصديق», apostille = «الأبوستيل», consular legalization = «التصديق القنصلي», standard admission letter = «خطاب القبول القياسي» (short labels keep «خطاب القبول»).
Greetings: Arabic has one greeting for afternoon and evening (مساء الخير); today.afternoon and today.evening are intentionally identical; morning punctuation aligned (comma, not يا).

university:kpi.yield rendered as «نسبة الالتحاق» (offers that led to enrollment); owner may prefer a longer gloss if the KPI tile allows. Reply owed = «رد مستحق» in both agency keys (inbox.needsReplyShort, students.noReplyShort).
